messages:
sam: Quick idea  'Console Roulette' this Friday in the mezzanine. bring any console (or deck) and a spare controller. we spin a wheel for matchups and swap games for rounds. casual. whos in? :game_die:

harper: omg yes. spinning wheel sounds chaotic. i'll bring my switch + a mystery indie cart.

lee: in. bringing PS5 and two extra controllers. also a small travel router in case we need local pairing.

mina: i'll bring snacks (and allergy labels). snacks-bot, remind me to add vegan option? :fork_and_knife:

snacks-bot: Reminder: Please label allergens. Suggested items: chips, fruit, vegan bars.

sam: rule ideas: one mystery key per person, rounds are 20 minutes, winners get to pick the next console or swap a game. remote folks can join via stream and get a raffle entry each round.

harper: love the pick-the-next-console rule. also can we do a silly hat bonus for first-spin? small prize.

lee: travel-router quick config if anyone needs it:
```
# travel-router quick
mode router
enable dhcp
ssid RedwoodRoulette
```

poll-bot: POLL by sam  "Start time" Options: "6:30pm", "7pm", "8pm". Votes: Sam (7pm), Harper (7pm), Lee (6:30pm), Mina (7pm).

sam: 7pm looks good. i'll reserve mezzanine 7-11pm and make a tiny wheel (paper) for the spin.

mina: signup sheet: https://sheets.example.com/s/console-roulette  i'll pin and add snack slots. please mark if you need a controller.

harper: remote folks: i'll stream and run a digital raffle; DM me if you want to enter.

dev-bot: Note: please do not connect office-prod switches to experimental travel routers. Keep guest network isolated.

lee: housekeeping: label chargers, no moving racks, and keep volume down after 10:30. one-key-per-person rule as usual.

sam: final: bring controllers, silly hats encouraged, tidy up after. see y'all Friday :party_parrot:
